item.description: Item to display as icon (fallback if no custom icon is provided)
item.markdownDescription: Item to display as icon (fallback if no custom icon is provided)

button_texture.description: Custom texture for the button background
button_texture.markdownDescription: Custom texture for the button background

icon.description: Custom texture for the button icon
icon.markdownDescription: Custom texture for the button icon

highlight_icon_texture.description: Custom texture for the icon when the button is hovered
highlight_icon_texture.markdownDescription: Custom texture for the icon when the button is hovered

highlight_button_texture.description: Custom texture for the button when hovered
highlight_button_texture.markdownDescription: Custom texture for the button when hovered

entity_action.description: Action to execute when this entry is clicked
entity_action.markdownDescription: Action to execute when this entry is clicked

condition.description: Optional condition to hide/show this entry
condition.markdownDescription: Optional condition to hide/show this entry

distance.description: Distance from center in pixels. When `-1`, defaults to screen height / 4
distance.markdownDescription: Distance from center in pixels. When `-1`, defaults to screen height / 4

velocity.description: Animation speed in pixels per tick. When `-1`, defaults to distance / 3
velocity.markdownDescription: Animation speed in pixels per tick. When `-1`, defaults to distance / 3

tooltip.description: Tooltip text shown on hover. If not provided and `item` is set, uses the item's name
tooltip.markdownDescription: Tooltip text shown on hover. If not provided and `item` is set, uses the item's name
